The `brgybnd` CLI converts **PSA** PSGC Excel/PDF snapshots into RDF linked data (W3C ORG ontology)
and matches **NAMRIA** shapefile boundaries with PSGC codes to produce **hierarchical per-class
GeoJSON** — the curated end product — plus `enriched` and `raw` stages as intermediate pipeline
outputs.

## Tech stack

Python 3.13 · Hatchling build · UV package manager · Click CLI · Pydantic v2 · rdflib · geopandas ·
OpenAI-compatible LLM client.

## Two parallel pipelines

The repository runs two independent pipelines side by side:

- **Pipeline A — PSGC → RDF.** Parses PSGC Excel/PDF snapshots, normalizes ~50 raw change types to
  10 canonical ones, builds an ORG-ontology RDF graph, and computes per-snapshot deltas. See
  [Pipeline A: PSGC → RDF](pipeline-rdf.qmd).

- **Pipeline B — NAMRIA → hierarchical GeoJSON.** Converts NAMRIA shapefiles to GeoJSON, enriches
  every polygon with its PSGC code (handling the [HUC mismatch](../references/huc-mapping.qmd)),
  classifies features by PSGC type/class, and splits into per-class files. See
  [Pipeline B: NAMRIA → hierarchical GeoJSON](pipeline-geo.qmd).

## Data tiers

Pipeline B produces three tiers: **raw** (NAMRIA-converted, pre-enrichment) → **enriched**
(`adm0`–`adm4` annotated with `psgc_code`/`name`/`status`/`match_confidence`) → **hierarchical**
(the curated per-class end product that GitHub Releases publish). See
[Pipeline B](pipeline-geo.qmd) and the [Boundaries overview](../boundaries/index.qmd).

## Install

The project is managed with [UV](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and targets Python 3.13. From a clone of
the repository:

```bash
# install dependencies into the project environment
uv sync

# expose the brgybnd CLI globally (optional)
uv tool install .
```

This installs the `brgybnd` entry point (`barangay_boundaries_repository/cli:cli`) — see the
[CLI reference](cli.qmd) for the 10 subcommands.

### Required inputs

`brgybnd` reads from two on-disk sources that are **not** committed to this repo (too large):

- **PSGC snapshots** — live under `$PSGC_DATA_DIR` (default `~/commons/barangay`), in per-snapshot
  `YYYY-MM-DD/` subdirectories of Excel/PDF files that `ingest/scanner.py` classifies. Set this in
  [configuration](configuration.qmd) or via the `PSGC_DATA_DIR` environment variable.

- **NAMRIA shapefiles** — committed under [`namria/`](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/tree/main/namria)
  (`phl_admbnda_adm{0-4}_*.shp`, version 2023-11-06).

The optional LLM batch-extraction step of [Pipeline A](pipeline-rdf.qmd) needs `OPENAI_API_KEY`
(defaults target the GLM API). Everything else runs offline. See
[configuration](configuration.qmd).

For a copy-paste quick start (install + first run), see the
[README](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository#readme).
